name: Super Muesli
ingredients: Whole Grains 68% {Rolled Oats, Brown Rice, Millets 20% (Jowar, Ragi, Bajra, Samai)}, Dehydrated Fruits 17% (Raisins, Strawberry Powder, Cranberry, Blackcurrant), Nuts & Seeds 8% (Almond, Pumpkin, Flax, Chia), Dates Syrup, Prebiotic Fibre (Fructo-oligosaccharide), Rice Bran Oil, Himalayan Pink Salt.
